description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CheckLater" name="Check again later notice"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Bank software frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest" name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="Start_BankRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankToAgencyRequest" name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyDelay" name="Scoring delay notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyLevel1Result" name="Level 1 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyLevel2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankDelayToFrontend" name="Check again later notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankResultToFrontend" name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankLevel2ToFrontend" name="Scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel1Result" name="Receive level 1 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel1Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendResultToFrontend" name="Send scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultPresented" name="Level 1 result presented at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" name="Send check again later notice to clerk"
                   messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" name="Send level 2 scoring result to frontend"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultPresented" name="Level 2 result presented at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_BankRequest" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel1Result" targetRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_SendResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_Level1ResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelay" targetRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_SendCheckLaterNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2ResultToFrontend" targetRef="End_Level2ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Receive scoring request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Can the result be determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel1Result" name="Send level 1 scoring result"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultSent" name="Level 1 result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay"
                   messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result"
                   messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendLevel1Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
